notes.title: I'm back. With an update.
notes.notes:
¤Added a button to kill yourself. If you get stuck or just can't take it anymore, press '0'
¤Don't use the chat. It's broken.
¤Changed the amount of XP you get from eating dots and players
¤Fixed the score reset issue that happened when a new player connected
¤Speed now resets properly when respawning so you don't go through walls like an electron.

I got a job so the updates will be slower than they were before. I'd rather only work on this, but I have bills. I saw a thing on the side where I can schedule an event. If that does what I think it does, I'll schedule one soon where everyone can get on at the same time and we can see what a full room is like.
